Why do safe dental implants usually require two separate trips 3–6 months apart?

Titanium or zirconia implants need three to six months to fuse biologically with your jawbone—a process called osseointegration—before supporting permanent chewing forces. Rushing permanent porcelain or zirconia bridges onto newly placed implants risks micro-movement, bone loss, and implant failure, which is why international prosthodontic protocols separate surgical placement from final bridge loading.

The [UK General Dental Council (GDC)](https://www.gdc-uk.org/standards-guidance/information-for-patients-public/going-abroad-for-dental-treatment) advises patients travelling abroad to understand full treatment stages before committing. Lower-jaw bone is typically denser and often heals in three to four months, whereas upper-jaw bone is softer and frequently needs four to six months—longer if sinus lifting or bone grafting is required. Clinics promising "permanent teeth in one five-day trip" usually place acrylic provisionals or overload fresh fixtures. For exact trip lengths, see our guide on [how many days you need in Türkiye for dental treatment](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/how-long-dental-trip-turkey).
Which international implant brands (Straumann, Nobel Biocare, Osstem) should be documented?

Your clinic should document the exact manufacturer, implant line, diameter, length, and lot number for every fixture placed. Globally distributed systems such as Straumann, Nobel Biocare, and Osstem ensure that a dentist in your home country can source compatible prosthetic screws, torque drivers, and replacement abutments years later without removing the implant.

items: [Straumann](https://www.straumann.com/en/dental-professionals/dental-implants.html): Swiss-engineered titanium, Roxolid, and ceramic systems backed by the [Straumann Guarantee](https://www.straumann.com/content/dam/media-center/straumann/en-us/documents/form/USLIT-479-Straumann-Guarantee.pdf) for product replacement through the treating clinician.

[Nobel Biocare](https://www.nobelbiocare.com/en-int/all-on-4-treatment-concept): Originator of the graftless All-on-4 concept, offering a [worldwide Warranty Program](https://www.nobelbiocare.com/en-int/warranty-program) when original Nobel components are used.

[Osstem Implant](https://en.osstem.com/company/company-outline): South Korean manufacturer with subsidiaries across 34 countries and EU CE MDR certification acquired in 2025, widely used as a mid-tier documented option.

body.text: Before flying home, verify your paperwork using this documentation checklist:

items: Original peel-off brand serial stickers affixed to an official implant passport
Exact fixture diameter, length, platform connection type, and jaw position chart
Abutment model and prosthetic screw specifications (torque values included)
Digital copies of pre-operative 3D CBCT scans and post-operative panoramic X-rays
Itemized invoice separating surgical fixtures from laboratory bridge fees

body.text: What happens on Visit 1 (extraction/implant) vs Visit 2 (permanent bridge)?

Visit 1 focuses on surgical foundation: 3D CBCT diagnostics, tooth extractions, bone contouring or grafting if needed, implant placement, and fitting temporary teeth over five to seven days. Visit 2 takes place three to six months later, focusing on stability checks, digital impressions, multi-stage lab try-ins, bite calibration, and final bridge fixation over seven to ten days.

body.text: Never compress Visit 2 into three days. Proper zirconia or porcelain full-arch bridges require a framework fit check, an aesthetic try-in, and at least one post-cementation bite review. Reviewing clinic credentials via our [dentist verification guide for Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/verify-dentist-turkey) helps confirm your prosthodontist and oral surgeon allocate realistic lab turnaround.
What temporary teeth do you wear between visits?

Between Visit 1 and Visit 2, your dental team fits either a fixed screw-retained acrylic provisional bridge (when primary implant torque is high enough for immediate loading) or a removable healing denture (when bone grafting or softer bone requires unloaded healing). Both protect your appearance during osseointegration while restricting hard chewing forces.

Fixed acrylic provisionals feel more stable for speaking and smiling, though clinicians typically prescribe a soft diet for eight to twelve weeks so implants do not shift. Removable temporary dentures may require soft relining at home as post-extraction gums shrink. faq.q: How long should I wait between Visit 1 and Visit 2 for All-on-4 in Türkiye?
faq.a: Most clinicians schedule Visit 2 between three and six months after Visit 1. Lower-arch cases often heal in three to four months, while upper-arch cases or grafted sites commonly need four to six months.

faq.q: Can I get permanent All-on-4 bridges in a single trip to Türkiye?
faq.a: Standard prosthodontic protocols avoid placing final heavy zirconia bridges on newly inserted implants in one week. Immediate-load bridges fitted on Visit 1 are normally lightweight acrylic provisionals designed for the healing phase.

faq.q: What is the difference between All-on-4 and All-on-6 dental implants?
faq.a: All-on-4 anchors a full-arch bridge on four implants, often angling the back two to avoid bone grafting. All-on-6 uses six implants to distribute biting loads across more bone when jaw volume permits.

faq.q: Do Straumann or Nobel Biocare warranties cover my return flights to Türkiye?
faq.a: No. Manufacturer guarantees from Straumann and Nobel Biocare replace defective hardware through a licensed clinician only. They exclude flights, hotels, chair time, and laboratory remakes.

faq.q: Can I eat normally with temporary teeth during the 3–6 month healing period?
faq.a: No. Patients wearing provisional bridges or healing dentures must follow a soft-food diet as directed by their surgeon to prevent micro-movement that disrupts osseointegration.
